subject: Pipeline scrub cadence & review pack grooming
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pipeline scrub cadence & review pack grooming

Team —

As we head into the Q4 leadership review window, I want to lock down a simple cadence for the monthly scrubs and the leadership review pack handoff. Goal: fewer last-minute edits and clean commits for the exec deck. Proposed plan below — please reply with objections or changes by EOD Monday (11/16).

Proposed cadence and artifacts:
- Weekly manager sync (30m) to resolve stuck deals (Tues 10:00 PT)
- Monthly scrub (first Thu of month) — managers update the pipeline template
- Two-week cut for leadership pack prep ahead of QBR (so leadership has a stable snapshot)

Key asks to managers:
1) Update pipeline_template_v3.xlsx (tab: commits) with stage, commit confidence, primary blocker by 11/22
2) Flag any deals needing CFO-level review by 11/24 (we'll loop Kevin)
3) Add a short one-line rationale for any >20% movement in ARR vs last snapshot

I attached the latest pipeline template and the leadership_pack_template.md — use the pack template for the one-page deal summaries. Also linking the Drive folder here: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/leadership-review-pack-2026-q4

If we want, Jonas can add a short ops checklist to the template for data hygiene (last contact, legal status, procurement stage).

Meet invite: I penciled a 45m grooming session for 11/22 09:30 PT to walk through examples and answer questions: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/8f3b-qa-scrub-2026-11-22

Thanks — please confirm availability and ownership for your teams.

— Ava Chen
Principal, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pipeline_template_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), leadership_pack_template.md (markdown)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline scrub cadence & review pack grooming

Ava —

Thanks for pulling this together. Leaning toward +1 on the cadence. Two quick asks from me:
- Can we add a "verified contacts" column so CS can confirm buyer champions before we lock commits? We had a slip last quarter because contacts were stale.
- For the CFO review list, can we make the threshold >$100k ARR instead of time-based? That will make the filter deterministic.

I'll tell my managers to update the template by 11/22. Happy to run the first weekly manager sync with Dylan.

— Grace
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline scrub cadence & review pack grooming

Agree with the plan. Two operational notes:
1) I'll drop a short ops_runbook.pdf in the Drive that outlines the exact steps to pull stage history and last activity — that'll help ensure consistency across managers.
2) For the leadership pack, please confirm whether you want ARR movement shown as absolute dollars or % change. I prefer both (column for $ impact + %), but if space is tight we can prioritize.

Also recommend we assign a point person per sales pod to own the pack row (avoid double edits). Happy to own pod A.

— Jonas
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ops_runbook.pdf (short guide)

Date: 2026-11-19T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline scrub cadence & review pack grooming — final timeline

Thanks team — consolidating next steps: 
- Managers to update pipeline_template_v3.xlsx (commits tab) by 11/22 EOD. Include verified contact, commit confidence, blocker note.
- Jonas to upload ops_runbook.pdf to the Drive by 11/18 (done) — use it to standardize history pulls.
- Kevin: we'll route the >$100k CFO review list to you on 11/24 for quick signoff.
- I'll run the 11/22 grooming session at 09:30 PT to walk examples (calendar link above). Please come prepared with 1–2 deal rows for us to walk through.

I'll take the lead on assembling the leadership pack snapshot on 11/25. Expect a draft by 11/26 for review.

Action owners: Ava (assemble pack), Jonas (ops runbook + $ columns), Grace & Dylan (manager updates), Marissa (exec distribution list).

— Ava
Principal, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
